title: 8 Claude Prompts To Land a Job
instagram:
Job hunting with Claude? Stop typing "write me a CV". 🤖

❌ Vague prompts give generic CVs.
✅ A role, your real inputs and a clear output give you a usable draft.

Here are 8 copy-paste prompts for your job search:

1️⃣ Tailor your CV
Match your real experience to each job post.

2️⃣ Write your cover letter
Short, specific, easy for a recruiter to scan.

3️⃣ Prepare for interviews
Mock questions, scores and stronger answers.

4️⃣ Build better connections
LinkedIn notes people actually reply to.

5️⃣ Negotiate your offer
A counter-offer email plus a call script.

6️⃣ Turn rejection into opportunity
Follow up and keep the door open.

7️⃣ Build your job-search plan
What to do every week, sized to your hours.

8️⃣ Research companies
Know the company before you apply.

Every prompt tells Claude not to invent experience. Fill the [BRACKETS] and paste.

Comment HIRED and I'll DM you every prompt.
Follow @withhammad.ai so the DM reaches you.
